Its terms, clause 9.6 Theme Store, say a Theme's intellectual property remains the designer's and its support is the designer's responsibility (SH-S-0052, SH-S-0053), and the partner dashboard has a Themes section (SH-I-2090): designers make the themes sold through Shopify's interface, extension-point. Theme fees is a billing charge category (SH-I-1354): shows.

A reading: Salla's Theme Marketplace is an admin link (/themes/marketplace, SA-S-1829), and Salla states it provided a theme store to install themes and preview them before buying (SA-S-5031); the flag theme-purchases is released for Plus, Pro and Special (SA-S-3387): core. Developers publish themes from the Partners Portal (SA-S-5104, My Themes SA-S-1908), and Salla calls itself an intermediary platform for hosting and publishing themes, not answerable for their quality (SA-S-0119): extension-point. The partner statements are SA-C-208's and SA-C-090's, which batch 2 lands.

A reading: apps add elements to the merchant's theme through theme app extensions, an extension target of Shopify's (SH-S-0705, SH-S-2238); app proxies and script tags are access scopes apps request (SH-S-6165, SH-S-0943, SH-S-6291, SH-S-6112). extension-point. The script tag scopes are SH-C-029's statements, cited here in the same tree.

The Snippet is injected automatically when your app is installed" (SA-S-0209), with its own API folder (SA-S-1074). extension-point. These are SA-C-198's statements, which batch 2 lands (U-049).
